about: Corrections to securities that the sources get wrong, applied by srm.py load security-fixes after the other identifier loaders (so they stay corrected). 'rules' retype by pattern (PostgreSQL regular expressions on the name, ticker and FMP industry), in order; 'fixes' then set a named security's type and / or name. 'remove' deletes securities that shouldn't be there (refused while an account holds them or a benchmark uses them), with their holdings-snapshot rows.

fixes.name: Liberty Media Corporation - Series B Common Stock
fixes.why: Liberty Media's Formula One Group tracking stock ended; FWONA and FWONK are common stock in OpenFIGI and nasdaqtrader, and FWONB is the same company's Series B. FMP's name 'Formula One Group' and OpenFIGI's 'Tracking Stk' are stale (2026-10-24).

rules.name: (\m(notes?|debentures?)\M.*\mdue\M|\m(senior|subordinated|junior subordinated|fixed[- ]rate|fixed-to-floating|fixed rate reset)\M.*\m(notes|debentures)\M|\mbaby bonds?\M)
rules.why: $25 notes and debentures that trade on NYSE / Nasdaq ('baby bonds'): debt, not equity. nasdaqtrader's files don't say what a line is.

rules.name: (\m(preferred|preference)\M|cumulative redeemable|non-?cumulative|perpetual|trust preferred|depositary shares?,? each representing a? ?1/)
rules.why: Preferred and preference shares (named so, or with a -P ticker) that came in as common stock.
Common shares of companies FMP classes as REITs (industry REIT - …).

rules.name: (\metns?\M|exchange[- ]traded notes?|\mipath\M|\metracs\M|microsectors|velocityshares)
rules.why: Exchange-traded notes — unsecured debt of the issuing bank, not funds — that nasdaqtrader's files flag as ETFs (MicroSectors, iPath, ETRACS …).
